programme.sub-title: WSOP 2004 Main Event Day 4

programme.title: World Series of Poker
programme.sub-title: WSOP 2004 Main Event Day 5

programme.title: World Series of Poker
programme.sub-title: WSOP 2004 Main Event Day 6 (Part 1)
programme.desc: Just 50 players return on Day 6 of the WSOP Main Event as Marcel Luske headlines the feature table along with John Murphy.
